assumptions.choice: Compute size = floor(available cash / current close) each entry and pass explicitly to self.buy(size=)/self.sell(size=), instead of a bt.Sizer
assumptions.reason: Spec states fixed 100% of capital per position; sizers are configured at the cerebro level which is outside this class, so sizing is computed manually to fulfill the stated rule.

assumptions.choice: Applied the same 100%-of-capital sizing formula to short entries as to long entries
assumptions.reason: Spec states risk management (100% of capital, no stop/take-profit) without distinguishing by trade direction.

assumptions.choice: Any crossing of the middle line (either direction) closes a mean-reversion position
assumptions.reason: Spec text for mean-reversion exits ('close on price crossing the middle line') states no direction, unlike the trend exit which explicitly says 'opposite crossing'.

assumptions.choice: Trend long exits only on a downward cross of the middle line; trend short exits only on an upward cross
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly calls trend exits the 'opposite crossing' of the middle line relative to the entry crossing direction (up for longs, down for shorts).

assumptions.choice: width == SMA(200,width) is classified as mean-reversion
assumptions.reason: Spec defines mean-reversion regime with a non-strict inequality (width ≤ SMA200), trend regime as strictly greater.

assumptions.choice: Track an internal position_type attribute (mr_long/mr_short/trend_long/trend_short) set on entry and cleared in notify_trade when the trade closes
assumptions.reason: Needed to route the correct exit rule (mean-reversion vs. trend, and directional vs. non-directional) since exits differ by how the position was opened; not itself a stated spec rule.
